handlers.name: edit
handlers.source: (fn [s msg] (assoc s "source" (get msg "source") "compiler" (get msg "compiler") "abi" (get msg "abi") "ready" false "hit" false))

handlers.name: complete
handlers.source: (fn [s msg] (if (and (= (get s "source") (get msg "source")) (= (get s "compiler") (get msg "compiler")) (= (get s "abi") (get msg "abi"))) (assoc s "cached-source" (get msg "source") "cached-compiler" (get msg "compiler") "cached-abi" (get msg "abi") "ready" true "hit" false) s))

handlers.name: reuse
handlers.source: (fn [s msg] (assoc s "hit" (and (get s "ready") (= (get s "source") (get s "cached-source")) (= (get s "compiler") (get s "cached-compiler")) (= (get s "abi") (get s "cached-abi")))))

handlers.name: edit
handlers.source: (fn [s msg] (assoc s "current" (get msg "revision") "ready" false "failed" false "admitted" false))

handlers.name: complete
handlers.source: (fn [s msg] (if (= (get s "current") (get msg "revision")) (assoc s "ready" true) s))

handlers.name: publish
handlers.source: (fn [s msg] (if (and (get s "ready") (= (get s "current") (get msg "revision"))) (assoc s "published" (get msg "revision") "failed" false "admitted" true) s))

handlers.name: fail
handlers.source: (fn [s msg] (assoc s "previous" (get s "published") "failed" true "ready" false "admitted" false))
